title: EvidenceAuditTrail
description: The evidence record together with its anchors, source-state resolutions, review events, and provenance activities — the full auditable history of one evidence occurrence.

sourceStateResolutions.description: Source states resolved for each anchor's evidence unit (via the profile's owner function).

provenanceActivities.description: Provenance activities over this evidence occurrence. Multiple activities MUST NOT inflate independent evidence count.

reviewEvents.description: Review events affecting this evidence record.
